question: For the three declared golden rectangles, do the oriented boundary words supply the missing term m in the Mellor-Melvin formula mu=m-t, and can the same raw triple-point count occur with mu=0?
level: External exact finite mathematics and a separately attributed visual observation; no native semantics or library growth

source.binding: Read only the literal rectangles assignment in golden_rectangle_checks by a restricted AST decoder; do not execute the historical module

imported_theorem.title: A geometric interpretation of Milnor's triple linking numbers
imported_theorem.published_pages: 559-562, definitions in section 2 and theorem on page 561
imported_theorem.formula: mu_ijk = m_ijk(F)-t_ijk(F) mod gcd(pairwise linking numbers)
imported_theorem.side_conditions: Three oriented embedded Seifert surfaces with pairwise disjoint link boundaries in general position; the checked PL rectangles have all intersections away from polygon corners and are locally smoothable there
imported_theorem.scope: This checker admits only pairwise-zero links, for which the residue is an integer. Unit mu does not classify ambient isotopy. The theorem is imported, not reproved or formalized.

geometry.field: a+b*sqrt(5), a,b exact rationals; independent implementation from the historical field class
geometry.surfaces: Three filled axis-aligned rectangles on distinct coordinate planes
geometry.orientation: Positive coordinate normals by default; boundary orientation checked from cross products. Component order is (z0,x0,y0).
geometry.events: Enumerate all four edges against both other surfaces; retain signed crossings in boundary traversal order, reject boundary contacts and nongeneric endpoint/coplanar events
geometry.triple_points: The unique candidate intersection of the three planes, admitted only when strictly interior to all three rectangles; sign from the determinant of the oriented normals

fixtures: golden rectangles from pinned source: expected (m,t,mu)=(0,1,-1)
uniform scale by 2 and common translation by (1,2,3): same verdict
replace phi by rational 2: same verdict, no golden-ratio uniqueness inferred
concentric squares of half-widths 3,2,1 in component order: expected (1,1,0), a counterexample to triple-count-only admission
move the third golden surface to y=10: expected (0,0,0)
seven other normal-sign assignments: multiply mu by the product of signs
five other component permutations: multiply mu by permutation parity
missing component, equal-width boundary contact, nonzero pairwise linking, and invalid normal: explicit refusals
independent_checks: Every degree-two boundary-word coefficient computed by signed ordered pairs and independently by multiplication of truncated noncommutative Magnus series
Pairwise linking sums agree in both directions; no H1 rank is treated as a linking-number calculation
Boundary orientation and triple-point sign checked explicitly
Cyclic basepoint shifts preserve coefficients in the pairwise-zero scope
Every fixture input survives JSON serialization/decoding and a fresh judgment
One optional separate process replay compares mathematical projections, excluding host costs
protected: Historical sources, contracts, evidence and library gitlink stay byte identical
No native Seal, free, universal grammar theorem, physical interpretation or working-word admission
The longitude/complement-side queue item remains Open; the surface route does not impersonate that independent route
Pixels supply observations and questions, never coordinates or evidence of an exact invariant
